title: Discovery starter
outcome: Frame a new initiative: agree the business objectives, set the solution scope and identify who is affected, so the work starts on a clear footing.

minimumInputs.help: What is the problem, in your own words?
minimumInputs.example: We pay suppliers late and lose discounts because approvals are slow.

minimumInputs.help: Who is this work for, or who will read the results?
minimumInputs.example: The finance director and the operations managers.

minimumInputs.help: What limits must be respected (budget, deadline, systems, rules)? Write "none known" if none.
minimumInputs.example: Must go live before the audit in March; cannot replace the finance system.

minimumInputs.help: What need, problem or opportunity is behind this work?
minimumInputs.example: Late approvals are costing us early-payment discounts.

minimumInputs.help: What should be different afterwards?
minimumInputs.example: Invoices approved and posted within five working days.

minimumInputs.help: Which part of the organisation, process or system is affected?
minimumInputs.example: Accounts payable and every manager who approves spend.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Targets you have not set are proposed for you to confirm.
What need does this meet, or what outcome should it produce?
minimumInputs.example: Invoices approved within five days instead of nine.

minimumInputs.help: Name the solution or change, and where it starts and stops.
minimumInputs.example: An approval workflow in front of the finance system; the finance system itself is unchanged.

minimumInputs.help: What limits must be respected (budget, deadline, systems, rules)? Write "none known" if none.
minimumInputs.example: Must go live before the audit in March; cannot replace the finance system.

minimumInputs.help: Optional. Anything you already know is out of scope. Otherwise Kryterea proposes exclusions for you to confirm.

minimumInputs.prompt: Scope plus at least one known affected group/person or explicit candidate group
minimumInputs.help: What is this work about, and name at least one group or person it affects (a guess is fine).
minimumInputs.example: Invoice approval; affects the accounts payable team and approving managers.

minimumInputs.help: Describe the situation as it is today.
minimumInputs.example: Invoices arrive as PDFs by email and are keyed in by hand.

minimumInputs.help: Which part of the organisation, process or system is affected?
minimumInputs.example: Accounts payable and every manager who approves spend.

minimumInputs.prompt: At least a user assertion or identifiable source
minimumInputs.help: Where does this information come from? Your own view counts; say so.
minimumInputs.example: My experience as the AP manager, and the finance team's monthly report.

minimumInputs.help: What is the work or goal these risks relate to?
minimumInputs.example: Roll out the approval workflow to all departments by June.

minimumInputs.help: What could go wrong or is uncertain, and why do you think so?
minimumInputs.example: The finance system interface is undocumented; IT has warned us.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Likelihood and impact scales are proposed if you have none.
What business need does this address?
minimumInputs.example: Stop losing early-payment discounts worth about 40,000 a year.

minimumInputs.help: What options could meet the need, including doing nothing?
minimumInputs.example: Do nothing; add reminders; buy an approval tool; build our own.

minimumInputs.help: What do you know or assume about costs and benefits? Rough figures are fine.
minimumInputs.example: Tool costs about 12,000 a year; discounts worth about 40,000.

minimumInputs.help: When does the decision need to be made, and over what period should it pay back?
minimumInputs.example: Decide by end of quarter; judge over three years.

minimumInputs.help: Nothing to fill in. Figures you do not have stay marked unknown, never invented.
